assessment: In this important study, the authors investigate the biogenesis of extracellular vesicles in mycobacteria and provide several observations to link VirR with vesiculogenesis, peptidoglycan metabolism, lipid metabolism, and cell wall permeability. The authors have done a commendable job of comprehensively examining the phenotypes associated with the VirR mutant using various techniques. The evidence presented in the revised manuscript is convincing and creates several avenues for further research.
